subject: Exec alignment: one-hour sprint demo & sponsor coordination
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novapulse.ai>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec alignment: one-hour sprint & sponsor coordination

Hi Ellen / Tom —

Thanks again for the quick sync yesterday. To make the leadership session as tight and actionable as possible, we propose a single "one-hour sprint" demo geared to VP + CIO (and CTO if helpful): 45 minutes demo + 15 minutes Q&A / next-steps.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Jun 22, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Jun 23, 14:00–15:00

If your VP/CIO prefers a shorter touchpoint, we can compress to 45 minutes with a 20-minute pre-brief for your sponsor to align success criteria — recommended if there are specific procurement/architecture asks.

Attached: the updated demo deck (v2) and a lightweight mutual-action-plan that maps outcomes + owners. Can you confirm which window works and whether you want a separate 20-min pre-brief with your VP?

Recording: we will record and share slides + a short highlight reel.

Thanks —
Priyom
Principal Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: demo-deck-v2.pdf (PDF, 3.1MB)]
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novapulse.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@novapulse.ai>, Procurement <procure@novapulse.ai>
Date: 2028-06-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec alignment: one-hour sprint demo & sponsor coordination

Thanks, Priyom — appreciate the clarity.

After checking calendars, our VP (Sharon Lee) wants a compact session that covers technical fit and business outcomes. Can we do a 45-minute sprint on Jun 22 at 10:00–10:45 PDT instead? Sharon will join for the first 30 minutes and then hand to the CTO (if available) for the final Q&A.

We’d like a short 20-minute pre-brief (internal) focused on success criteria: top 3 metrics we should validate in the demo, and any compliance redlines to flag ahead of time. Can someone from Redwood run that pre-brief on Jun 22 at 09:35 PDT?

Also looping in Procurement — we’ll need the standard SOW + PO path. If you can send a statement of work outline and a DocuSign link for an engagement letter, that will speed things up.

Perfect — we can do Jun 22, 10:00–10:45 PDT as a 45-minute sprint.

Logistics proposal:
- 09:35–09:55 PDT: Sponsor pre-brief (20 min) — goals: align on the 3 success criteria and any compliance/blue-team must-haves. Priyom and I will lead.
- 10:00–10:45 PDT: Demo (45 min) — 30-min product walkthrough + 15-min Q&A.

Backup coverage: If Sharon needs to drop at 10:30, I will hold until 10:45. Laura will own post-demo follow-ups & next steps capture.

I attached a trimmed mutual-action-plan with owners assigned and a short checklist for the pre-brief (items: network allowlist, recording consent, data retention question).

If Procurement needs a SOW outline, I’ll attach a one-page scope after this thread (or share via DocuSign link).

Marcus

Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — confirmed: Jun 22, 09:35 PDT pre-brief, 10:00–10:45 PDT demo. Sharon and our CTO will attend as planned.

Procurement: we’ve reviewed the outline — please send PO/engagement instructions. Priyom / Marcus, please share the SOW one-pager and the DocuSign engagement link; we’ll try to turn the PO within 5 business days after the demo.

One request: can Redwood mark the recording as 1) internal only and 2) provide a separate transcript? That helps our legal/compliance review.

Looking forward —
Tom
Head of Platform Partnerships
Novapulse AI
